topic: Wrong hours on your listing turn people away before they ever call.

slides.subtitle: (your listing says so)
slides.scene: A blank unmarked sign hanging on the inside of a glass workshop door on a chain, completely blank on both sides, warm daylight outside and a dim workshop behind. All vehicles, buildings, doors and surfaces in shot have COMPLETELY BLANK panels with absolutely no writing, no company name, no logo, no lettering, no phone number and no graphics of any kind. No signage anywhere in the scene. There is NO text, no words, no numbers and no labels anywhere in the image.

caption:
Did you know your online listing might be telling people you are closed right now?

Most contractor listings were set up once, years ago, by somebody guessing. Nine to five, Monday to Friday. Then the business changed, the hours changed, and nobody went back.

So somebody searches at seven in the evening with a problem, sees closed, and never rings. You do not get a missed call. You do not get anything. They filtered you out before you existed to them.

The same goes for a holiday you set two Christmases ago and never removed.

This takes about four minutes to check and it is the single cheapest thing on this list. Search your own trade and your own town on a phone that is not yours, and look at what a stranger sees.

Save this one and go and look tonight.
